status_note: The one adoption switch. NOT IN FORCE: Deviations 65 and 67 are drafts, not rows of the pre-registration (v0.18.0 is in force). While this says not_in_force, everything computed from this table is exploratory and says so, and gradvar.analysis.gates.gate2_e evaluates the clause as registered. Set it to in_force in the commit that adopts the two rows; the loader refuses in_force while any entry below is provisional.
registered_note: 'registered' is the value the adopted rows fix (Deviations 65 and 67 as corrected by the reviews). The loader refuses an in-force table in which an entry has no registered value or holds another value than its registered one: while the table is in force, an edit of 'value' cannot change a registered rule. An entry without 'registered' has not been ruled on.
basis: Draft docs/deviations_drafts/65_execution_time_calibration_2026-11-10.md (branch dev65-execution-calibration) as corrected by the independent review docs/reviews/review_dev64_dev65_dev66_2026-11-10.md (11 Nov 2026, corrections C65-1 to C65-8, Sections 5.3 and 8.5), which the lead adopted with the PI's authorisation as relayed by the operator on 10 Nov 2026. 'provisional: false' means the review confirmed or replaced the entry; 'provisional: true' means the entry was found in implementation and no review has ruled on it.

primary_calibration.basis: confirmed by the review (Section 8.5 item 1), with the four cases of C65-1 fixed in code
primary_calibration.meaning: Which calibration the registered row is drawn on. per_value_at_or_before_running: for every published value, the entry with the latest date at or before the job's running time among the updates of the pool; a stamp-dated entry is that of the update in force at running; with no entry dated at or before running, the entry of that update; of two entries with one date and two values, the later update's; a value that update does not carry is missing.

coupler_zone_rule.basis: confirmed by the review (Section 8.5 item 2); written into row 67 (i)
coupler_zone_rule.meaning: When a coupler over the CZ cut counts as lying in the L = 2 cone of the observable: both of its qubits in the cone, or either.

coupler_cone_rule.basis: found in implementation; the review does not rule on it
coupler_cone_rule.meaning: When a coupler over the CZ cut counts as lying in the point's own light cone (the 'elsewhere in the cone' flag). either_qubit is the reading that never drops a flag.

zone_for_points_shallower_than_zone.basis: found in implementation; the review does not rule on it
zone_for_points_shallower_than_zone.meaning: zone_applies: an over-cut element in the L = 2 cone makes a point not evaluable whatever its L. own_cone_only: for a point with L below 2 only its own cone counts.

decision_line_abs_ln_ratio.allowed: a positive number, or null for no line (flags only)
decision_line_abs_ln_ratio.basis: value confirmed, consequence replaced by the review (C65-3, Section 8.5 item 3): above the line the point is not evaluable, automatically
decision_line_abs_ln_ratio.meaning: A flagged point whose |ln(P_E / P_dispatch)| exceeds this is not evaluable. Nobody decides.

when_execution_calibration_cannot_be_bui.basis: replaced by the review (C65-4, Section 8.5 item 8): neither of the draft's two options
when_execution_calibration_cannot_be_bui.meaning: E is then built by the same rule from the properties files committed by the snapshot workflow and every reading on it is flagged 'E from committed snapshots'; when no committed file closes the pool the job's points are not evaluable. The dispatch-time row is reported beside and is never the registered reading.

split_point_rule.basis: confirmed by the review (Section 8.5 item 9), which adds: the strictest classification among the jobs (C65-1; fixed in code)
split_point_rule.meaning: How a point whose executions are split over jobs with different execution-time calibrations is read.

value_age_bound_hours.allowed: null (ages recorded, no bound) or a positive number of hours
value_age_bound_hours.meaning: A bound on the age at running of the readout values of the execution-time calibration. null: the age of every value class is recorded and nothing is refused.

bracket_decides_gate2e.basis: confirmed by the review (Section 8.5 item 5): E decides, B is reported
bracket_decides_gate2e.meaning: Whether an element over a cut on the bracket calibration also pauses under Gate 2 (e). Read by gradvar.analysis.gates.gate2_e.

bracket_zone_flag.basis: added by the review (C65-6) and taken by the lead
bracket_zone_flag.meaning: An element on the observable edge or in its L = 2 cone that is over a cut on the bracket calibration and not on E makes the point read with a flag.

rerun_rule.basis: Deviation 67 (iii), option (iii) of the review's Section 5.3, taken by the lead on the PI's rule as relayed
rerun_rule.meaning: Whether a job is re-run once when the classifier marks one of its points not evaluable on calibration grounds alone (gradvar.rerun_decision). none: no job is re-run (option (ii)).

dispatch_window.basis: confirmed by the review with added sentences (C65-5, Section 8.5 item 4). An update is a change of values: a re-stamp without one is not 'the update that follows'
dispatch_window.meaning: The window in which a package may be dispatched. Read by no code on this branch; it belongs to the same-day pipeline scripts.
